states.narration: The first coefficient is negative one and the second is three. Both multiply the unchanged group x+2.
Distributivity collects the two coefficients as negative one plus three, leaving the shared group intact.
Negative one plus three equals two. Only the coefficient sum is evaluated.

editorial.title: A valid collection beyond nonnegative coefficients
editorial.setup: Consider a negative coefficient multiplying the same group as a positive coefficient. This probes mathematics beyond the documented source task's supported coefficient range.
editorial.summary: Real-number distributivity gives a total coefficient of two, while x+2 remains unchanged. The supported authoring task may reject this valid negative-coefficient chain.
